blurbs.suggested: Mistakes that keep coming back. Train them, or dismiss the ones you don't care about.
blurbs.improving: The error rate has halved since training began.
blurbs.mastered: Down to a quarter of where they started. They return to training if they come back.
blurbs.dismissed: Not suggested again unless you restore them.
blurbs.watching: Seen, but not often enough to suggest yet. “train now” starts training one anyway.
blurbs.overview: Where your fingers go wrong, drawn on the keyboard, with the words and spaces beside it. Each line shows the error rate over recent tests.
blurbs.all: Every mistake Kalibre has noted, whatever its status.

empty.suggested: No mistakes here yet. You're doing good!
empty.training: No mistakes in training yet. Add some from the 'suggested' tab.
empty.improving: Nothing improving yet. Keep drilling your training mistakes.
empty.mastered: Nothing mastered yet. Training takes time — keep at it.
empty.watching: Nothing here yet. Keep typing and patterns will show up.
empty.all: No mistakes noted yet. As you type, Kalibre records recurring patterns here.
